meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

copy.tagline: 用组合模式重构组件，消除布尔属性泛滥
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构组件或设计可复用的组件库
copy.tagline_en: Refactor components with composition patterns to eliminate boolean prop proliferation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring components or designing reusable component libraries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 React 组合模式（如复合组件、状态提升）来重构组件，避免使用大量布尔属性，并生成更易维护的代码。
howto.when: 当你要求重构带有许多布尔属性的组件、构建可复用的组件库或设计组件 API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个表单组件，避免使用太多布尔属性。
say.note: Claude 会应用复合组件模式来拆分。

say.text: 用复合组件模式重写这个下拉菜单。
say.note: Claude 会创建共享上下文的子组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will refactor components using React composition patterns like compound components and state lifting, avoiding boolean prop proliferation and producing more maintainable code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor components with many boolean props, build reusable component libraries, or design component APIs.

say_en.text: Refactor this form component to avoid too many boolean props.
say_en.note: Claude will apply compound component pattern.

say_en.text: Rewrite this dropdown using compound components.
say_en.note: Claude will create subcomponents with shared context.
